facts.text: Under the Four-Year Graduation Guarantee, any remaining coursework required to complete a degree won't cost the student if Chaminade does not hold up its end of the bargain.

sources.title: Four-Year Graduation Guarantee - Chaminade University of Honolulu
sources.quote: We're here to make sure you graduate in four years. And if we don't hold up our end of the bargain, any remaining coursework required to complete your degree won't cost you. That's right, those courses will be free.

facts.text: Through the Hawaii Guarantee program, Chaminade pledges to keep tuition costs stable for students throughout their four years of undergraduate study.

sources.title: Hawaii Guarantee - Chaminade University of Honolulu
sources.quote: Through this program, Chaminade pledges to keep tuition costs stable for students throughout their four years of undergraduate study, providing peace of mind and financial stability for both students and their families.
